_readme: Every specification actually evaluated on this project, in order.
This file is the honest N behind the deflated Sharpe ratio. Under-report it and
the deflated Sharpe is inflated, which defeats the point of computing it at all.
Append a row EVERY time you evaluate a specification end to end -- including the
ones you abandon, especially the ones you abandon. sharpe_annual is the net
annualised Sharpe of that specification's stitched holdout backtest, or null
where the run was abandoned before a backtest existed.
All figures below are on synthetic data. Replace them wholesale when the study
is re-run on real data; a trial count from one dataset does not transfer.

trials.name: car_market_model_0_19 target, entry at t0
trials.notes: ABANDONED. Booked the announcement gap, which is untradable. Produced a Sharpe above 2 on the null fixture, which is how the bug was found. See ADR 0003.

trials.name: car_market_model_1_20 target, entry at t0+1, weight cap clipped
trials.notes: ABANDONED. Clipping weights after sector demeaning left up to 8% net sector exposure, so the book was not actually neutral.

trials.name: car_market_model_1_20, ridge, sector-neutral, rank_gauss, cap scaled
